title: When the Ghost Burns
author: Lior Winterbourne
blurb: Noor Crane, a whistle-blower living under four names, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. But when a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must extract a defector who may be the bait, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
